issue_title: Public header: icon-only search and help, plus a Get Involved page (flat events menu)
problem_statement:
Public header: icon-only search and help, plus a Get Involved page (flat events menu)

## Problem
Mark wants the events.allthingsai.org top menu flattened, after the Dribbble "JoyToys" pattern: centered text links, small round icon buttons on the right, **no dropdowns**, a **"?" icon with no "Help" text**, and a **magnifying glass for search** instead of the text field.
Owner decision 2026-09-14: **option A, flat two bars**.
Wireframe (low-fi, attached per doctrine): https://claude.ai/code/artifact/62d69b20-c93d-42e8-bb80-25b9e89517f5

## Core changes (ConferenceOS `main`, all tenants)
1. **Icon-only search in the parent-site bar.** The utilities show a round magnifying-glass button, not the text field. Activating it opens the existing `SearchForm`; ⌘K / Ctrl+K opens and focuses it; Escape closes it. The accessible name stays "Search" and the form keeps `role="search"`. The phone menu panel keeps its full search field.
2. **Icon-only help trigger.** `ContextualHelpPanel` shows only the CircleHelp "?" icon, with no visible "Help" text. The accessible name, `title`, panel, and route-help gating are unchanged.
3. **Get Involved page** at `/events/[eventSlug]/get-involved`. It lists the same participation options as today's default "Participate" menu, from one shared function so the two cannot drift:
   - Submit a Talk, only while `cfpOpen`;
   - Register, only while registration shows;
   - Apply for a Scholarship;
   - Volunteer;
   - Sponsor the event.

   Each option is a card with a one-line description and a link. The default grouped event nav is unchanged.

## Not code (ATA data, after release)
- The flat header uses the existing per-event header override (`NavItem` `scope=EVENT`, `placement=HEADER`, "Event header" editor): Schedule · Speakers · Sponsors · Venue & Travel · FAQ · Get Involved.
- Parent-bar rows flattened to Events · Webinars · Speak · Sponsor · About · News.
- Moved links go to footer rows.
- Other sites keep their dropdowns.

## Acceptance
- Header tests updated for icon-only search and help, with keyboard behaviour (open, ⌘K, Escape, focus) and accessible names asserted.
- A Get Involved page test covers the option set under `cfpOpen` true/false and register shown/hidden, via the shared function; the nav test still passes against the same function.
- The page returns `notFound` for an unknown event and handles CANCELLED like the sibling pages do.
- a11y/link-name suites stay green.
